shaft_radius = shaft_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, hub_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (hub_radius, hub_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (hub_radius, hub_length + shaft_length))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (shaft_radius, hub_length + shaft_length))

        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[0]
bottom_edges = bottom_face.edges()
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_edges, chamfer_size)
